orders_or_contracts.statement: Preferential issue of up to 11,02,42,980 equity shares of face value Re. 1/- each at an issue price of Rs. 7.80 per share (including premium of Rs. 6.80 per share) amounting to Rs. 85,98,95,244/- to shareholders of Ampivo Smart Technologies Private Limited for consideration other than cash, by way of swap of equity shares of Ampivo, towards acquisition of 66,212 equity shares representing 43.44% of equity share capital of Ampivo.

The Board of Directors of the Company ("Board"), at its meeting held on 03rd September, 2026, considered and approved, subject to approval of the Members and such other approvals as may be required, the proposal to acquire up to 66,212 equity shares of Ampivo Smart Technologies Private Limited ("Ampivo"), representing 43.44% of the equity share capital of Ampivo, from its existing shareholders, by way of a share swap arrangement between Company, Ampivo and its shareholders dated 03.09.2026.

outlook.statement: The Company expects that the strategic initiatives undertaken by the management, including business expansion, operational improvements, technology adoption and prudent financial management, will contribute towards improved operational performance and sustainable profitability over the medium to long term.

Digitally onboard 20 million farmers, open 1,000 smart agri-stores, and facilitate transactions with a GMV of USD 1 billion through rural commerce, sale of agri-inputs and market access for agricultural produce over the next three years under Project AVIO.
Focus on strengthening Financial Inclusion & Digital Services core business and improving utilisation of rural distribution network.

Scale Agri Supply Chain & Technologies: strengthen Project AVIO, expand agri ecosystem across Agri Commerce, Trade Finance, Smart Retail, Crop Advisory; target 20 million farmer onboarding, 1,000 smart agri-stores, USD 1 billion GMV over three years.
Progress Diagnostics & Healthcare through Huwel partnership: validation, commercial development, market expansion, deployment of diagnostic technologies across Indian and global markets.
The Company has planned expansion of export markets in the coming years.

The management of the Company is in the process of regularizing the Compliances related to Foreign Subsidiaries and closure of such subsidiaries under the applicable legal framework in respective jurisdiction.

risks: The Company may, in certain financial years, have inadequate profits owing to market conditions, expansion plans, capital investments, industry-specific factors or other business considerations affecting profitability.
Strategic objectives subject to market conditions, execution and applicable regulatory approvals
Agri concentration and execution risk: Agri segment ~58% of FY26 revenue; sustaining growth with margins and working-capital discipline.
Execution and integration risk: Multiple new partnerships and associates; effective integration and commercial contribution critical.
Diagnostics commercialisation risk: Diagnostics & Healthcare pre-revenue; returns depend on validation, adoption, regulatory, scale-up.
Working-capital and market risk: Agri commerce expansion may require working-capital management; affected by commodity prices, demand, supply-chain dynamics.
Credit risk: Financial Inclusion business exposed to credit/collection risks and macro-economic conditions affecting rural borrowers.
Agricultural and monsoon-related risk: Agricultural activity and rural income sensitive to monsoon and output factors.
Regulatory and technology risk: Changes in financial-services, agriculture, healthcare, technology regulations; cybersecurity and technology-adoption risks.
Legacy matters: Non-functional foreign subsidiaries written off in prior years remain under regularisation for compliance and closure.
Related-party funding risk: Promoter-related inter-corporate funding creates additional exposure subject to terms, repayment, approvals, disclosures.
